assets.processing: 250 curated core/non-core fishing harbours with display names (e.g. Rivière-au-Renard, Daajing Giids), DFO region and coast assigned by province and location; 36 marked major. Approach points (open water, mostly 1-4 km off; up to ~6.5 km for inlet harbours, ~13.5 km for Pangnirtung's fjord) derived from a Natural Earth 10m water raster. Generated by scripts/generate-fleet.mjs; cached inputs and provenance in scripts/data/SOURCES.md.

assets.source: Synthetic: generated by scripts/generate-fleet.mjs (seed 20261124); land mask from Natural Earth 10m land 5.1.1 + minor islands 4.1.0 (https://naturalearth.s3.amazonaws.com/10m_physical/); area labels from data/atlantic.geojson (NAFO) and data/pacific.geojson (PFMA)
assets.license: Synthetic demonstration data (no third-party content); Natural Earth: public domain
assets.processing: 2,799 invented vessels (names, CFV numbers, licences, grounds, routes, phases) by region and fishery; offshore grounds sampled on named banks/shelf edges and kept in Canadian-fished waters; routes by A* on a conservative water raster (0.02° Atlantic, 0.01° Pacific) and string-pulled, all points and segments on water. Not CFIS or DFO records. Deterministic: re-running yields identical bytes.
